name: Adjoint Sensitivity Method
summary: Compute gradients of scalar objectives with respect to many physical parameters through an adjoint solve.
core_idea: Introduce an adjoint variable to eliminate explicit differentiation of every state with respect to each parameter.
innovation: Can reduce gradient cost when the number of parameters is large and the objective dimension is small.

start_here.why: Accessible adjoint derivation grounded in linear algebra and PDE examples.
start_here.focus: Derive adjoint gradients and distinguish continuous/discrete adjoints.

curation_note: Original methodological formulation reviewed; starting reference is advisory, not a quota.
